title: Contrastive Activation-Guided Zeroth-Order Preference Optimisation for Memory-Efficient LLM Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.20635v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) simplifies reinforcement learning from human feedback, but still relies on traditional backpropagation and its associated activation-memory cost. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimisation avoids backpropagation, yet isotropic perturbations can produce noisy updates for preference objectives defined by differences between chosen and rejected responses. We introduce Contrastive Activation-guided Zeroth-Order Direct Preference Optimisation (CA-ZODPO), which constructs a low-rank search subspace from the activation discrepancy between the chosen and rejected responses in each preference pair. Perturbations are restricted to this subspace, while momentum is maintained in low-rank coordinates to preserve the memory advantages of ZO training. translated_title: 面向内存高效大语言模型对齐的对比激活引导零阶偏好优化
translated_abstract: 直接偏好优化（DPO）简化了基于人类反馈的强化学习，但仍依赖传统的反向传播及其带来的激活内存开销。零阶（ZO）优化虽然避免了反向传播，但各向同性的扰动对于由选定响应与被拒绝响应之间差异所定义的偏好目标而言，可能产生含噪声的更新。我们提出了对比激活引导零阶直接偏好优化（CA-ZODPO），该方法从每个偏好对中选定与被拒绝响应之间的激活差异构建一个低秩搜索子空间，将扰动限制在该子空间内，同时在低秩坐标中保持动量，以保留零阶训练的内存优势。在Qwen2.5-1.5B模型与Anthropic HH-RLHF数据集上的实验表明，CA-ZODPO优于常见的零阶基线方法，并在成对偏好评估中与一阶DPO保持竞争力。它还降低了峰值内存开销……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CA-ZODPO方法，通过从偏好对中选定与被拒绝响应的激活差异构建低秩搜索子空间来引导零阶优化，在不使用反向传播的情况下实现内存高效的大语言模型偏好对齐，其性能媲美一阶DPO。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CA-ZODPO, which guides zeroth-order preference optimisation by constructing a low-rank search subspace from the activation discrepancy between chosen and rejected responses in each preference pair, achieving memory-efficient LLM alignment without backpropagation while remaining competitive with first-order DPO.
